description: The workspace's saved replies: answers the team gives often, each with a name, its text ({name} becomes the person's username), an optional /shortcut, and keywords. A saved reply with keywords is drafted under each new comment no auto-reply answers that mentions one, so it's ready in Inbox for one tap. kept false: nothing is kept yet, and the list shows suggestions (replies the team sent more than once, plus starters) for saved_replies_refresh to keep.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
